summary.text: Michele Grim is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 43 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A health policy analyst and former Toledo city councilmember, she is the ranking member of the Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Michele Grim was born in Ashland, Ohio, and lives in Toledo, according to Ballotpedia.

She earned a B.A. in women and gender studies from the University of Toledo in 2005, a master's of public health from the Northwest Ohio Consortium for Public Health in 2007, a graduate certificate in sexuality education from the University of Michigan in 2011, and a doctor of law and policy from Northeastern University in 2020.

Her career experience includes working as a health coach and educator in Lucas County, a risk reduction educator for the AIDS Resource Center Ohio, an epidemiologist for the Toledo-Lucas County health department, a grants management specialist for the AIDS Project of the East Bay, and a health policy researcher and educator.
Grim held an at-large seat on the Toledo City Council before the Ohio House, according to Ballotpedia.
She succeeded Rodney Creech (R) in District 43 and assumed office on January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism, House Finance and House Health committees and is the ranking member of the Transportation Committee.
